description: A PostHog workflow (hog flow): a trigger followed by a graph of actions (messages, delays, branches) that PostHog runs for each person who enters it.

Hash.description: HogQL template defining the dedup/grouping key, e.g. {person.id} (once per person within Ttl).

Ttl.description: Seconds (60 to 94608000) to suppress repeat firings of the same hash.

Threshold.description: Fire once per N matches of the same hash within Ttl (a sampler: N=3 fires on the 1st, 4th, 7th match). Omit to fire on the first match, then suppress repeats within Ttl.

Count.description: Maximum number of emails this workflow sends per period.

Period.description: Window the count applies to. Sends over the limit are delayed until capacity frees up, not dropped.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the workflow belongs to.

Tags.description: Tags for organizing workflows, for example by team or use case. Tags are shared with the rest of the project.

OriginProduct.description: Product surface that owns this workflow, e.g. `loops`. Can only be set on create.

Actions.description: Ordered action nodes as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString): [{"id", "name", "type", "config", "description"?, "on_error"?, "filters"?, "output_variable"?}]. Exactly one action with type `trigger` is required (its config defines the workflow trigger), and typically one `exit`. Types: trigger, function, function_email, function_sms, function_push, delay, wait_until_condition, wait_until_time_window, conditional_branch, random_cohort_branch, exit, email_sandbox.

Edges.description: Graph edges as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString): [{"from", "to", "type": "continue"|"branch", "index"?}]. `branch` requires `index` (into config.conditions of a conditional_branch or wait_until_condition). Every non-exit action needs a reachable next action.

Conversion.description: Conversion goal as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString): {"filters": [property filters], "events": [{"filters": {"events": [...]}}], "window": "7d"}. Required for the exit_on_conversion exit conditions.

ExitCondition.description: When people leave the workflow early. `exit_only_at_end` (the PostHog default), `exit_on_conversion` (needs Conversion), `exit_on_trigger_not_matched` or `exit_on_trigger_not_matched_or_conversion`. Only event and cohort triggers are re-checked.

TriggerMasking.description: Optional dedup/throttle on an already-matched trigger.

EmailSendingRateLimit.description: Optional email pacing for deliverability. Omit to disable pacing.

Variables.description: Workflow variables as a JSON array (use Fn::ToJsonString): [{"key", "type": "string"|"number"|"boolean", "default"}]. Total under 5 KB.

Trigger.description: The workflow trigger as JSON, derived by PostHog from the config of the trigger action.

Version.description: Version of the workflow, incremented on every change.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change.
